transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get moving on the temporary support annex. As you know, we've got two rooms available — East and West — and both can be made ready by tomorrow morning. We need to place an equipment-issue desk and a protected medical-records desk. Before I sign off on room assignments and the required controls, I need facilities and signal to report any room, infrastructure, or opening requirements they're aware of. Let's hear it — what do we need to know before we open these desks?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a floor-load concern before we assign rooms. The equipment-issue desk's steel storage cabinet weighs 1,100 kilograms when stocked. I verified the floor-load ratings this morning — East Room is rated for 800 kilograms and West Room is rated for 1,500 kilograms. That cabinet cannot go in East Room; it needs to go in West Room. I should note the floor-load figures haven't been added to the relocation worksheet yet, but the measurements are confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, I have a critical infrastructure requirement to report. The protected medical-records desk can only connect to the required isolated network through the fiber patch panel located in the East Room. My signal technician is already booked to certify that connection tomorrow morning from 0900 to 1000 — I received the booking confirmation this morning. However, that booking is not yet on the annex opening checklist, so we need to get it added. This means the protected medical-records desk needs to go in East Room, which also aligns with Maj. Alvarez's floor-load concern since that desk doesn't have the heavy steel cabinet.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Add the confirmed floor-load ratings (East Room 800 kg, West Room 1,500 kg) to the relocation worksheet.
Add the signal technician's fiber patch panel certification booking (0900-1000 tomorrow) to the annex opening checklist.
